detail.longDescription: Annotation QA tip: most label noise comes from vague guidelines, not careless annotators. Before labeling 1,000 items, write down 3 things: 1. What counts as the object/entity (and what doesn't) 2. How to handle edge cases (occluded, partial, ambiguous) 3. 2-3 examples of right vs wrong Then label 50 items, review the disagreements, fix the guidelines, repeat. Cheaper than relabeling later.
